name: Chicken Piccata
description: Tender chicken breasts with a bright caper and white wine sauce. Best served with pasta.
gist: Chicken with caper and white wine sauce.
ingredients:
2 chicken breasts
1/4 cup flour
1/3–1/2 white onion
2–5 cloves garlic
2–3 tbsp capers
1/2 cup white wine
Optional: chili flakes
1–2 cups chicken stock
1–2 tbsp lemon juice
Butter (a lot)
Pasta for serving (e.g., linguini)
Optional: parsley
steps:
1. Begin boiling water if making noodles; cook and drain, reserving pasta water.
2. Cut chicken breasts in half and pound flat.
3. Season with salt and pepper; lightly coat in flour.
4. Heat oil in a skillet and sear chicken; remove before fully cooked.
5. Add onion and garlic to skillet; reserve some garlic for noodles; add oil and chili flakes if desired.
6. Once softened, add capers and a splash of brine.
7. Add white wine and reduce by 1/2–2/3.
8. Add chicken stock and bring to simmer; enough liquid to cook chicken and create sauce.
9. Return chicken to simmering liquid.
10. Once cooked, add lemon juice to taste.
11. Turn off heat and add several tablespoons of butter; remove chicken for plating.
12. For noodles, heat butter, olive oil, and garlic (optionally chili flakes).
13. Add cooked noodles and reserved pasta water; toss to form a rich, creamy, garlicky sauce.
